<div class="field field--field-rich-text wfp-wrapper clearfix">

        
      <div class="field-rich-text--container mv4 mv5-lg">
    <div>
              <p>For decades, Palestine has faced a protracted humanitarian crisis driven by <strong>conflict, displacement, economic decline and restricted access</strong> to resources and services.</p>
<p>The situation deteriorated significantly following a sharp escalation of violence in October 2023, leaving<strong> families across Gaza and the West Bank struggling to meet their basic needs.</strong></p>
<p>Food security conditions in Gaza have improved since a ceasefire was announed in October 2025, chiefly due to large-scale humanitarian assistance.</p>
<p>However, the situation remains extremely fragile. According to the latest <a href="https://www.wfp.org/stories/5-steps-food-security-famine">Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) analysis</a>, <strong>1.4 million people – around two thirds of the population – are experiencing crisis or worse </strong>levels of acute food insecurity. </p>
<p>Many families continue to rely on emergency coping strategies, while access to diverse and nutritious diets remains limited.</p>
<p>Each month, the <strong>World Food Programme (WFP) reaches 1.5 million people in Gaza</strong> with food parcels, wheat flour, bread, hot meals, nutrition services and cash assistance. </p>
<p>Together with partners, <strong>WFP also supports bakeries, community kitchens and livelihood activities</strong> that help families meet immediate needs while strengthening local markets and resilience.</p>
<p>Continuing insecurity, restricted humanitarian access, damaged infrastructure, unemployment and limited livelihood opportunities continue to undermine recovery and food security. <strong>If humanitarian assistance is not sustained, food insecurity could rapidly worsen.</strong></p>
<p>In the <strong>West Bank</strong>, increasing violence, displacement and economic hardship are placing additional pressure on vulnerable households. </p>
<p>WFP provides<strong> food assistance, cash support, nutrition services and livelihood programmes </strong>to help families withstand the ongoing crisis and build a pathway towards recovery.</p>

  <h2 class="page-stripe__title wfp-wrapper">What the World Food Programme is doing in Palestine</h2>

          <dt class="accordion__item-title" data-js-hook="accordion__item-title" tabindex="0" aria-controls="accordion-panel-1" aria-expanded="true">
        <div>
          <h3>Food assistance</h3>
        </div>
      </dt>
      <dd class="accordion__item-panel" id="accordion-panel-1" aria-hidden="false">
        <div class="accordion__item-content">WFP provides food assistance through food parcels, wheat flour distributions, bakeries, community kitchens and cash-based transfers. In Gaza, WFP reaches around 1.5 million people each month with a combination of food parcels, wheat flour, bread, hot meals, cash assistance and nutrition support. WFP also supports bakeries with wheat flour and fuel, and provides digital cash transfers to help families purchase food. Together with partners, WFP delivers nutrition services for pregnant and breastfeeding women and young children, including both malnutrition prevention and treatment support.</div>

Photo: WFP/Mostafa Ghroz">
              </div>
                                  </aside>
              </dd>
          <dt class="accordion__item-title" data-js-hook="accordion__item-title" tabindex="0" aria-controls="accordion-panel-2" aria-expanded="false">
        <div>
          <h3>Livelihood support</h3>
        </div>
      </dt>
      <dd class="accordion__item-panel" id="accordion-panel-2" aria-hidden="true" inert="">
        <div class="accordion__item-content">WFP supports livelihood activities that help households and communities maintain and restore sources of income. Working with national institutions and local organizations, WFP implements activities including climate-resilient agriculture, greenhouses, vegetable farms, sheep and poultry production, and technical and vocational training for youth and people with disabilities. In Gaza, WFP also supports cash-for-work activities and works with retailers, traders and communities as they recover livelihoods and rebuild local economic activity where conditions allow.</div>

                          <div class="accordion__item-image">
                <img src="https://www.wfp.org/sites/default/files/styles/page_accordion/public/images/Palestine-livelihood-support-WFP-Ali-Jadallah.jpeg?itok=JDpF-Fmc" alt="For Noora tomatoes are red gold. In the photo, Noora is in her greenhouse, arranging her freshly picked tomatoes in boxes to use at home or send to family and friends. Photo: WFP/Ali Jadallah">
              </div>
                                  </aside>
              </dd>
          <dt class="accordion__item-title" data-js-hook="accordion__item-title" tabindex="0" aria-controls="accordion-panel-3" aria-expanded="false">
        <div>
          <h3>Capacity strengthening</h3>
        </div>
      </dt>
      <dd class="accordion__item-panel" id="accordion-panel-3" aria-hidden="true" inert="">
        <div class="accordion__item-content">WFP works with national institutions to strengthen food security systems and improve the ability to respond to shocks and crises. This includes providing tools, technical expertise and guidance to support food security monitoring and analysis, strengthen the National Social Safety Net, and expand livelihood projects. WFP also supports national partners in protecting food systems and improving the evidence base used for food security decision-making. Through these activities, WFP contributes technical expertise alongside its humanitarian and development programmes.</div>

                <img src="https://www.wfp.org/sites/default/files/styles/page_accordion/public/images/Palestine-capacity-strenghthening-WFP-Mostafa-Ghroz.jpeg?itok=6ZRxoqm2" alt="WFP supports national institutions with technical expertise and capacity building trainings to boost their ability to respond to natural disasters. Photo:WFP/Mostafa Ghroz">
              </div>
                                  </aside>
              </dd>
          <dt class="accordion__item-title" data-js-hook="accordion__item-title" tabindex="0" aria-controls="accordion-panel-4" aria-expanded="false">
        <div>
          <h3>Enabling partners</h3>
        </div>
      </dt>
      <dd class="accordion__item-panel" id="accordion-panel-4" aria-hidden="true" inert="">
        <div class="accordion__item-content">WFP provides shared services that support the wider humanitarian response in Palestine. Through our cash-based transfer platform, we help humanitarian and development organizations deliver assistance to people in need. WFP also provides logistics coordination and supports an inter-agency community feedback mechanism that allows partners to collect and respond to feedback from affected communities. These systems help humanitarian organizations coordinate assistance and reach people more effectively across Palestine.</div>

<div class="field field--field-rich-text wfp-wrapper clearfix">

        
      <div class="field-rich-text--container mv4 mv5-lg">
    <div>
              <p>Senegal faces worrying levels of food insecurity, due to a combination of factors including inadequate access to food, inappropriate infant and young childcare and feeding practices, poor hygiene and sanitation practices, and insufficient access to drinking water and health services. In total, <strong>1.3 million people faced acute food insecurity during the lean season in 2023. </strong></p>
<p>Climate change has damaged food production through frequent <strong>heatwaves, droughts – particularly in the north – and flooding</strong>. This combines with poor land management and other factors such as deforestation in the south. At the same time, cumulated crises, from the war in Ukraine to poor harvests and regional instability, have driven up the price of food and transport services.</p>
<p>World Food Programme (WFP) support includes providing <strong>emergency assistance, for example through digital transfers, while building resilience to climate shocks</strong> through supporting sustainable livelihoods. We support the government’s national social protection programme, which aims to tackle chronic poverty and strengthen the resilience of vulnerable communities.</p>

  <h2 class="page-stripe__title wfp-wrapper">What the World Food Programme is doing in Senegal</h2>
  



<section class="accordion wfp-wrapper">

  <dl class="accordion__items" data-js-hook="accordion__items" data-once="accordion">
          <dt class="accordion__item-title" data-js-hook="accordion__item-title" tabindex="0" aria-controls="accordion-panel-1" aria-expanded="true">
        <div>
          <h3>School meals </h3>
        </div>
      </dt>
      <dd class="accordion__item-panel" id="accordion-panel-1" aria-hidden="false">
        <div class="accordion__item-content">WFP provides daily hot meals to  schoolchildren from vulnerable households. Schools are supported with digital cash transfers, to provide the canteens with locally produced food. This in turn encourages local agricultural production and thereby increases incomes among the local community. However, challenges in securing prompt, flexible funding has particularly affected our school meals programme, forcing us to halve the number of schools supported.</div>
                  <aside class="accordion__item-side">
                          <div class="accordion__item-image">
                <img src="https://www.wfp.org/sites/default/files/styles/page_accordion/public/images/Senegal-school-feeding-WFP-Evelyn-Fey.jpg?itok=90PgcqPC" alt="Kids eating healthy and nutritious school meals">
              </div>
                                  </aside>
              </dd>
          <dt class="accordion__item-title" data-js-hook="accordion__item-title" tabindex="0" aria-controls="accordion-panel-2" aria-expanded="false">
        <div>
          <h3>Nutrition</h3>
        </div>
      </dt>
      <dd class="accordion__item-panel" id="accordion-panel-2" aria-hidden="true" inert="">
        <div class="accordion__item-content">WFP works with government institutions, civil society, the private sector, UN agencies and donors to provide specialized nutritious food, among other products, to people living in vulnerable areas, including children aged under 5, pregnant and breastfeeding women, and people living with HIV. In addition, WFP also offers communication activities for behaviour and diet change, for example through radio broadcasts.</div>
                  <aside class="accordion__item-side">
                          <div class="accordion__item-image">
                <img src="https://www.wfp.org/sites/default/files/styles/page_accordion/public/images/3_9.jpg?itok=E7PFcgzR" alt="Demonstration of the weighing of a baby as part of the "Community nutrition service packages delivered as part of the Nutrition Reinforcement Programme" (PRN) project in the village of Pout, in Thiès.">
              </div>
                                  </aside>
              </dd>
          <dt class="accordion__item-title" data-js-hook="accordion__item-title" tabindex="0" aria-controls="accordion-panel-3" aria-expanded="false">
        <div>
          <h3>Resilience</h3>
        </div>
      </dt>
      <dd class="accordion__item-panel" id="accordion-panel-3" aria-hidden="true" inert="">
        <div class="accordion__item-content">WFP's resilience interventions help communities exposed to climate shocks, building resilient livelihoods and ecosystems needed to develop sustainable food systems. In practice This includes building half-moons, stone barriers and dykes to collect and control rainwater, training farmers in biopesticide-production techniques, tree cultivation and water management, creating green jobs for young people, and creating village savings and loans associations.</div>
                  <aside class="accordion__item-side">
                          <div class="accordion__item-image">
                <img src="https://www.wfp.org/sites/default/files/styles/page_accordion/public/images/2_13.jpg?itok=Cg3X3Hbw" alt="Mother of a household, beneficiary of the 4R Project, as part of risk reduction activities - through WFP's Food Assistance for Assets (FAA), climate services and market development. ">
              </div>
                                  </aside>
              </dd>
          <dt class="accordion__item-title" data-js-hook="accordion__item-title" tabindex="0" aria-controls="accordion-panel-4" aria-expanded="false">
        <div>
          <h3>Capacity strengthening</h3>
        </div>
      </dt>
      <dd class="accordion__item-panel" id="accordion-panel-4" aria-hidden="true" inert="">
        <div class="accordion__item-content">WFP works to strengthen the capacity of the Government and partners at all levels to manage food security and nutrition strategies by providing training and technical support in food security and nutrition analysis, early warning, insurance, supply chain management and emergency preparedness and response, with a special focus on gender.</div>

      <div class="field-rich-text--container mv4 mv5-lg">
    <div>
              <p>Although Colombia is classified as an upper-middle income country, it ranks second in Latin America and the Caribbean and seventh in the world in terms of income inequality.</p>
<p>Food security improved between 2022 and 2023. However, <strong>one out of four Colombians are food insecure. </strong></p>
<p>One of the main catalysts for food insecurity is armed conflict. There will unlikely be peace with high levels of food insecurity, and food-insecure people may become victims of conflict and illicit businesses.</p>
<p>A peace agreement between the Government and Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC) in 2016 signaled an end to almost six decades of conflict, though other armed groups still operate in the country.</p>
<p>The conflict left hundreds of thousands of people dead, displaced 8.4 million people and was characterized by widespread human rights violations. </p>
<p>While it is a generational task to mitigate the consequences of decades of conflict, the fact <strong>conflict continues in many parts of the country represents a serious hurdle to achieving food security. </strong></p>
<p>The World Food Programme (WFP) supports the Government's efforts to achieve zero hunger through approaches including cash-based transfers, local purchases through farmers' associations and the promotion of sustainable enterprises. These tools also work to prevent malnutrition, including micronutrient deficiencies and obesity, especially in school-aged children.  </p>
<p>Ensuring that the most vulnerable populations have permanent<strong> access to a nutritious, balanced and diversified diet is the focus of WFP's actions in Colombia. </strong></p>
<p>Children, breastfeeding and pregnant women, ethnic groups, victims of violence, confined and displaced communities, smallholder farmers, migrants and host communities are the population groups identified as priorities to ensure their food and nutrition security.</p>

          <div class="paragraph paragraph--type-page-accordion paragraph--view-mode-full mv4 mv5-lg clearfix">
  <h2 class="page-stripe__title wfp-wrapper">What the World Food Programme is doing in Colombia</h2>
  



<section class="accordion wfp-wrapper">

  <dl class="accordion__items" data-js-hook="accordion__items" data-once="accordion">
          <dt class="accordion__item-title" data-js-hook="accordion__item-title" tabindex="0" aria-controls="accordion-panel-1" aria-expanded="true">
        <div>
          <h3>Capacity strengthening </h3>
        </div>
      </dt>
      <dd class="accordion__item-panel" id="accordion-panel-1" aria-hidden="false">
        <div class="accordion__item-content">WFP provides local public and private institutions with technical support for the development of policies and the design, delivery and evaluation of programmes to address malnutrition and food insecurity, with a special focus on former conflict areas. It aims to improve capacities in disaster risk reduction and in strengthening the country’s social protection system, hoping to make it more shock responsive. Building on WFP’s experience implementing school meals in La Guajira and in many countries in the world, WFP aims to help many departments in Colombia to improve their school meal programmes with a focus on local procurement.</div>
                  <aside class="accordion__item-side">
                          <div class="accordion__item-image">
                <img src="https://www.wfp.org/sites/default/files/styles/page_accordion/public/images/col_20150223_wfp-mike_bloem_0061.jpg?itok=qm9xmWlt" alt="Women farming with support provided by WFP's programmes to improve food security and nutrition in Colombia">
              </div>
                                  </aside>
              </dd>
          <dt class="accordion__item-title" data-js-hook="accordion__item-title" tabindex="0" aria-controls="accordion-panel-2" aria-expanded="false">
        <div>
          <h3>Food security</h3>
        </div>
      </dt>
      <dd class="accordion__item-panel" id="accordion-panel-2" aria-hidden="true" inert="">
        <div class="accordion__item-content">WFP works with victims of violence – including internally displaced people and returnees – and vulnerable populations to ensure they have adequate access to nutritious, varied food. Children at risk of forced recruitment – especially in remote rural boarding schools – or affected by displacement, are supported through a school meals programme in La Guajira, Colombia’s most food-insecure department. The programme is designed to build local ownership and linked to local production.</div>
                  <aside class="accordion__item-side">
                          <div class="accordion__item-image">
                <img src="https://www.wfp.org/sites/default/files/styles/page_accordion/public/images/col_20150222_wfp-mike_bloem_0002.jpg?itok=0rYzYpZ3" alt="Fishermen supported by WFP to increase access to means of livelihood and nutritious meals in Colombia">
              </div>
                                  </aside>
              </dd>
          <dt class="accordion__item-title" data-js-hook="accordion__item-title" tabindex="0" aria-controls="accordion-panel-3" aria-expanded="false">
        <div>
          <h3>Nutrition</h3>
        </div>
      </dt>
      <dd class="accordion__item-panel" id="accordion-panel-3" aria-hidden="true" inert="">
        <div class="accordion__item-content">WFP promotes nutrition-related training and communication campaigns adapted to the context of vulnerable populations, tailored to address the gender and age of recipients. Local governments receive support to prevent malnutrition, with special attention on the first 1,000 days of life and a focus on pregnant and nursing women, adolescent girls and children under 5.</div>
                  <aside class="accordion__item-side">
                          <div class="accordion__item-image">
                <img src="https://www.wfp.org/sites/default/files/styles/page_accordion/public/images/col_20150225_wfp-mike_bloem_0158.jpg?itok=H5IAB-jp" alt="Woman and her child, beneficiaries of WFP's malnutrition-preventing programme in target groups in Colombia">
              </div>
                                  </aside>
              </dd>
          <dt class="accordion__item-title" data-js-hook="accordion__item-title" tabindex="0" aria-controls="accordion-panel-4" aria-expanded="false">
        <div>
          <h3>Support for smallholder farmers </h3>
        </div>
      </dt>
      <dd class="accordion__item-panel" id="accordion-panel-4" aria-hidden="true" inert="">
        <div class="accordion__item-content">To enhance the production and marketing capacities of smallholder farmers, WFP is providing training to ensure they meet demand requirements (including quality standards, reliability of supply, adding value to raw products, use of native species and environmentally sound agricultural practices) and promoting efficient procurement models that link smallholder production to public and private markets. The approach emphasizes the work of women's associations in rural areas of the country, and also promote social cohesion. WFP is aiming to involve private sector partners a lot more proactively in this space.</div>
                  <aside class="accordion__item-side">
                          <div class="accordion__item-image">
                <img src="https://www.wfp.org/sites/default/files/styles/page_accordion/public/images/uga_20100723_wfp-frederic_courbet_0024.jpg?itok=NBxba8pA" alt="Nutrient-rich beans, produced by farmers with the support of WFP in Colombia">
              </div>
                                  </aside>
              </dd>
          <dt class="accordion__item-title" data-js-hook="accordion__item-title" tabindex="0" aria-controls="accordion-panel-5" aria-expanded="false">
        <div>
          <h3>Resilience and livelihoods </h3>
        </div>
      </dt>
      <dd class="accordion__item-panel" id="accordion-panel-5" aria-hidden="true" inert="">
        <div class="accordion__item-content">Integrated actions support community-based, inclusive and sustainable natural resource management and adaptation to climate change, building on the analysis of climate trends and forecasts. Activities build resilience, using incentives such as food transfers or cash-based transfers, to recover ancestral practices and traditional knowledge, and improve dietary diversity and rebuild livelihoods in areas vulnerable to climate change.</div>
                  <aside class="accordion__item-side">
                          <div class="accordion__item-image">
                <img src="https://www.wfp.org/sites/default/files/styles/page_accordion/public/images/col_20150224_wfp-mike_bloem_0088_0.jpg?itok=7Ubcl1_Z" alt="Farmer pointing to his luscious farm which was made possible by the support of WFP to smallholder farmers in Colombia">
              </div>
                                  </aside>
              </dd>
      </dl>

</section>

      <div class="field-rich-text--container mv4 mv5-lg">
    <div>
              <p>Yemen remains one of the <strong>world’s most urgent humanitarian crises.</strong> Today, 19.5 million people – including around 15 million women and children – face the compounding effects of prolonged conflict, climate shocks, disease outbreaks and a deepening economic collapse. Without immediate and sustained assistance, conditions are expected to deteriorate further, <strong>pushing millions closer to famine.</strong></p>
<p>An estimated 4.8 million people remain internally displaced across Yemen, many living in camps with limited access to basic services. While a 2022 truce led to a reduction in internal hostilities, the situation remains deeply fragile. Regional escalations, including <strong>cross-border strikes and large-scale cuts to humanitarian assistance</strong>, have heightened risks. This threatens to undo hard-won humanitarian gains achieved over recent years.</p>
<p><strong>The World Food Programme’s (WFP) activities are essential to millions across Yemen. </strong>Support includes emergency food assistance for families affected by conflict, fortified snacks to encourage school attendance, targeted nutrition support for malnourished children and mothers, and long-term solutions that build resilience through asset creation and livelihood initiatives.</p>
<p><strong>WFP calls for urgent and sustained international support</strong> to address the high levels of food insecurity and malnutrition in Yemen. By providing families with reliable food and nutrition assistance, WFP can help stabilize communities and prevent famine.</p>

          <div class="paragraph paragraph--type-page-accordion paragraph--view-mode-full mv4 mv5-lg clearfix">
  <h2 class="page-stripe__title wfp-wrapper">What the World Food Programme is doing in Yemen</h2>
  



<section class="accordion wfp-wrapper">

  <dl class="accordion__items" data-js-hook="accordion__items" data-once="accordion">
          <dt class="accordion__item-title" data-js-hook="accordion__item-title" tabindex="0" aria-controls="accordion-panel-1" aria-expanded="true">
        <div>
          <h3>Food assistance</h3>
        </div>
      </dt>
      <dd class="accordion__item-panel" id="accordion-panel-1" aria-hidden="false">
        <div class="accordion__item-content">WFP provides emergency food assistance to vulnerable families across Yemen, helping them meet their basic needs amid widespread food insecurity. In areas where access permits, WFP distributes food rations every 45 days, prioritising communities facing the highest levels of food insecurity.</div>
                  <aside class="accordion__item-side">
                          <div class="accordion__item-image">
                <img src="https://www.wfp.org/sites/default/files/styles/page_accordion/public/images/Yemen-food-assistance-WFP-Jihad-AlNahari.jpg?itok=8v6noiTc" alt="WFP food basket distributed to beneficiaries at a WFP food distribution point in Marib Al-Wadi district, Marib">
              </div>
                                  </aside>
              </dd>
          <dt class="accordion__item-title" data-js-hook="accordion__item-title" tabindex="0" aria-controls="accordion-panel-2" aria-expanded="false">
        <div>
          <h3>Cash</h3>
        </div>
      </dt>
      <dd class="accordion__item-panel" id="accordion-panel-2" aria-hidden="true" inert="">
        <div class="accordion__item-content">WFP provides cash assistance in southern Yemen in areas where markets are stable enough to provide for communities' basic food needs. The amount of cash assistance a family receives is based on the number of household members. Cash assistance injects much-needed liquidity into the economy and allows families to buy the items they need the most.</div>
                  <aside class="accordion__item-side">
                          <div class="accordion__item-image">
                <img src="https://www.wfp.org/sites/default/files/styles/page_accordion/public/images/WF1961490%208.10.2024-%20CBT%20HADRMOT-Sayoun%2CYE-BCHR%20By-%20Hani%20Saleh%20%2817%29.jpg?itok=MZ4XeMzw" alt="Close-up of man counting out money">
              </div>
                                  </aside>
              </dd>
          <dt class="accordion__item-title" data-js-hook="accordion__item-title" tabindex="0" aria-controls="accordion-panel-3" aria-expanded="false">
        <div>
          <h3>Nutrition</h3>
        </div>
      </dt>
      <dd class="accordion__item-panel" id="accordion-panel-3" aria-hidden="true" inert="">
        <div class="accordion__item-content">WFP provides specialized nutritious food to young children and pregnant and breastfeeding women suffering from moderate acute malnutrition. We also strengthen the capacity of Ministry of Public Health and Population staff working at local health centres, as well as community health volunteers. This enables them to identify malnutrition cases and educate community members on better health and nutrition practices.</div>
                  <aside class="accordion__item-side">
                          <div class="accordion__item-image">
                <img src="https://www.wfp.org/sites/default/files/styles/page_accordion/public/images/WF1782404_20230608_WFP_YEM_Mehedi-Rahman_DSCF3509%20%281%29_0.jpg?itok=ZWse2PmO" alt="Two children eating nutritional snack">
              </div>
                                  </aside>
              </dd>
          <dt class="accordion__item-title" data-js-hook="accordion__item-title" tabindex="0" aria-controls="accordion-panel-4" aria-expanded="false">
        <div>
          <h3>School meals</h3>
        </div>
      </dt>
      <dd class="accordion__item-panel" id="accordion-panel-4" aria-hidden="true" inert="">
        <div class="accordion__item-content">Under the school meals programme, WFP provides primary-school children with fortified biscuits each day they attend school. WFP also runs a Healthy Kitchen project that provides locally sourced and freshly prepared school meals with fruits and vegetables, aiming to give children the nutrients they need and help them form healthy eating habits.</div>
                  <aside class="accordion__item-side">
                          <div class="accordion__item-image">
                <img src="https://www.wfp.org/sites/default/files/styles/page_accordion/public/images/WF1813255_YEM-20231003-ALAA-NOMAN-%2887%29%20%281%29_0.jpg?itok=yEILriYo" alt="Boy eating a food roll in classroom">
              </div>
                                  </aside>
              </dd>
          <dt class="accordion__item-title" data-js-hook="accordion__item-title" tabindex="0" aria-controls="accordion-panel-5" aria-expanded="false">
        <div>
          <h3>Logistics</h3>
        </div>
      </dt>
      <dd class="accordion__item-panel" id="accordion-panel-5" aria-hidden="true" inert="">
        <div class="accordion__item-content">WFP is the logistical backbone of humanitarian operations in Yemen. We transport humanitarian workers through our United Nations Humanitarian Air Service, and move supplies such as fuel for other humanitarian organizations through the Logistics Cluster. Additionally, WFP, through our Emergency Telecommunications Cluster, helps keep humanitarian workers connected by providing essential telecommunications services in areas that would otherwise have very poor or no connection.</div>
                  <aside class="accordion__item-side">
                          <div class="accordion__item-image">
                <img src="https://www.wfp.org/sites/default/files/styles/page_accordion/public/images/WF1827813_YEM-20240109-ALAA-NOAMAN-.jpg?itok=TRVoPzzi" alt="UNHAS worker standing at side of airport ">
              </div>
                                  </aside>
              </dd>
      </dl>

</section>

      <img loading="lazy" src="/sites/default/files/styles/media_embed/public/2022-07/Lenarcic%20and%20the%20ED_for_landing_smaller.jpg?itok=Nf15x218" width="600" height="340" alt="ED">

<h1 class="stripe-video__title"><span class="halden">WFP's Partnership with the EU</span></h1>
<p>Rising to meet these challenges, the European Union showed its commitment to the world’s most vulnerable once again. In 2021, the European Commission alone contributed €424 million and was WFP’s third largest donor.</p>
<p>The European Commission’s <strong>Directorate-General for European Civil Protection and Humanitarian Aid Operations</strong> (DG ECHO) allowed WFP to address the world’s worst emergencies, helping us reach the most vulnerable in countries affected by conflict, climate change and economic crises. The EU's humanitarian funding allowed WFP to save lives in the most severe emergencies and implement innovative solutions to effectively help those in need.</p>
<p>Thanks to support from the European Commission’s <strong>Directorate-General for International Partnerships </strong>(DG INTPA), WFP worked to address the root causes of hunger, providing communities around the globe with sustainable and long-term solutions to lift them out of hunger and poverty — ranging from resilience building and livelihoods activities to nutrition and school meals programmes.</p>
<p>Together with the European Commission’s <strong>Directorate-General for Neighbourhood and Enlargement Negotiations </strong>(DG NEAR), WFP helped strengthen national social safety nets in countries like Lebanon, allowing us to provide cash assistance to both vulnerable refugees and impoverished host communities.</p>
<h3 paraeid="{dec8fb2e-1ce9-437d-a746-dfa3e24014f7}{135}" paraid="819874087">Across the European Union</h3>
<p paraeid="{dec8fb2e-1ce9-437d-a746-dfa3e24014f7}{142}" paraid="1214219171">In addition to working with the European Commission to fight hunger around the globe, WFP has also developed strong partnerships with the other EU institutions in Brussels, particularly the <strong>European Parliament</strong>, the <strong>Council of the European Union</strong> the <strong>European Union External Action Service </strong>(EEAS) and the <strong>Service for Foreign Policy Instruments</strong> (FPI). </p>
<p>WFP, FAO and the EU are also the founding members of the <a href="http://www.fightfoodcrises.net/" data-once="wfpCampaignGAEvents">Global Network Against Food Crises</a>, and together we publish an annual report — called The Global Report on Food Crises — with the latest numbers on people facing acute hunger and malnutrition in crisis-prone countries. WFP also worked closely with the EU at high-level pledging conferences during the year, including the <a href="https://www.eeas.europa.eu/eeas/brussels-v-conference-%E2%80%93-supporting-future-syria-and-region_en" data-once="wfpCampaignGAEvents">Brussels V Syria Conference</a> and the <a href="https://reliefweb.int/report/yemen/yemen-eu-co-hosts-humanitarian-community-meeting-famine-looms" data-once="wfpCampaignGAEvents">Yemen Senior Official Meeting</a>.</p>
<p>WFP also participated in a high-level dialogue on <a href="https://youtu.be/KHpwxydLJrw?t=1618" data-once="wfpCampaignGAEvents">anticipatory action against food crises</a>, and at the Brussels launch of the Global Humanitarian Overview. We also hold frequent briefings with members of the European Parliament, and have addressed the <a href="https://multimedia.europarl.europa.eu/en/webstreaming/committee-on-development_20210713-1400-COMMITTEE-DEVE" data-once="wfpCampaignGAEvents">Parliament's Committees on Development</a> and <a href="https://www.europarl.europa.eu/delegations/en/d-af/home#:~:text=The%20Delegation%20for%20relations%20with%20Afghanistan%20is%20a%20standing%20body,a%20broad%20range%20of%20issues." data-once="wfpCampaignGAEvents">Delegation for relations with Afghanistan</a>. WFP also held several other meetings and exchanges with the EU throughout the year, including technical exchanges with <strong>DG INTPA and The Directorate-General for Climate Action (DG CLIMA) </strong>on our common climate action priorities, and with DG INTPA on digital transformation initiatives.</p>

<div class="field field--field-rich-text wfp-wrapper clearfix">

        
      <div class="field-rich-text--container mv4 mv5-lg">
    <div>
              
<div class="align-right media--image media-single-image__wrapper">
  
      <img loading="lazy" src="/sites/default/files/styles/media_embed/public/2022-06/WF1229947_20210526_ETH_Claire-Nevill_0007.jpeg?itok=kjzsBFO6" width="900" height="675" alt="Woman in Ethiopia with child">
  </div>
<h1 class="stripe-video__title" style="text-align:left"><span class="halden">Ethiopia</span></h1>
<p style="font-size:16pt;font-weight:400;line-height:1.5;">A catastrophic combination of conflict in the north and climate shocks in the south pushed millions of people into hunger. The conflict in Northern Ethiopia in 2021 reversed progress made in achieving food security in many parts of the country. WFP had to respond quickly and at scale. But thanks to donors like the EU, WFP kept the UN Humanitarian Air Service (UNHAS) in the skies and connected aid workers to hard-to-reach areas.</p>
 
          </div>
  </div>
  
</div>

  </div>

 
    <div class="paragraph paragraph--type-rich-text paragraph--view-mode-full">
      
<div class="field field--field-rich-text wfp-wrapper clearfix">

        
      <div class="field-rich-text--container mv4 mv5-lg">
    <div>
              
<div class="align-left media--image media-single-image__wrapper">
  
      <img loading="lazy" src="/sites/default/files/styles/media_embed/public/2022-07/WF1144718_20210207_NGA_DamilolaOnafuwa_11.jpg?itok=o7YNjeLZ" width="900" height="600" alt="wf1144718_20210207_nga_damilolaonafuwa_11.jpg">
  </div>
<h1 class="stripe-video__title" style="text-align:left"><span class="halden">Nigeria</span></h1>
<p style="font-size:16pt;font-weight:400;line-height:1.5;">In North-Eastern Nigeria, conflict affects the lives and livelihoods of millions of people. Joint efforts by the Nigerian Government, the humanitarian community and donors like the EU have helped reach nearly two million people in 2021 and have managed to stabilise an extremely serious food security situation. </p>
 
          </div>
  </div>
  
</div>

  </div>

 
    <div class="paragraph paragraph--type-rich-text paragraph--view-mode-full">
      
<div class="field field--field-rich-text wfp-wrapper clearfix">

        
      <div class="field-rich-text--container mv4 mv5-lg">
    <div>
              
<div class="align-right media--image media-single-image__wrapper">
  
      <img loading="lazy" src="/sites/default/files/styles/media_embed/public/2022-06/Jess_5.jpeg?itok=HtFi_4SL" width="868" height="578" alt="Syria">
  </div>
<h1 class="stripe-video__title" style="text-align:left"><span class="halden">Syria</span></h1>
<p style="font-size:16pt;font-weight:400;line-height:1.5;">At a time when humanitarian needs across Syria were greater than ever with more than 12 million people food-insecure, funding from the EU helped Syrian families boost their nutrition with a combination of food and cash assistance. Support from the EU also helped UNHAS ensure safe and reliable transport for humanitarians across the country. </p>
 
          </div>
  </div>
  
</div>

  </div>

 
    <div class="paragraph paragraph--type-rich-text paragraph--view-mode-full">
      
<div class="field field--field-rich-text wfp-wrapper clearfix">

        
      <div class="field-rich-text--container mv4 mv5-lg">
    <div>
              
<div class="align-left media--image media-single-image__wrapper">
  
      <img loading="lazy" src="/sites/default/files/styles/media_embed/public/2022-06/DRC.jpeg?itok=rVUcF0nP" width="800" height="534" alt="DRC">
  </div>
<h1 class="stripe-video__title" style="text-align:left"><span class="halden">DRC</span></h1>
<p style="font-size:16pt;font-weight:400;line-height:1.5;">Protracted conflict has uprooted millions of people from their homes across the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). Some 27 million people were food-insecure in 2021, fuelled by poor harvests, conflict, disease and collapsing infrastructure. Funding from the EU helped WFP provide cash assistance to the most vulnerable, helping them put food on the table. </p>
 
          </div>
  </div>
  
</div>

  </div>

 
    <div class="paragraph paragraph--type-rich-text paragraph--view-mode-full">
      
<div class="field field--field-rich-text wfp-wrapper clearfix">

<div class="align-right media--image media-single-image__wrapper">
  
      <img loading="lazy" src="/sites/default/files/styles/media_embed/public/2022-06/lesotho.png?itok=se0Vi2f9" width="602" height="339" alt="Lesotho">
  </div>
<h1 class="stripe-video__title" style="text-align:left"><span class="halden">Lesotho</span></h1>
<p style="font-size:16pt;font-weight:400;line-height:1.5;">The combination of climate change, a worsening economy and the impact of COVID-19 pushed many into food insecurity in Lesotho. Late rains and severe droughts reduced agricultural yields and the pandemic heavily affected livelihoods. In response, WFP provided cash transfers to people living in urban areas to help them get by, thanks to donors like the EU. </p>

<h1 class="stripe-video__title" style="text-align:left"><span class="halden">Haiti</span></h1>
<p style="font-size:16pt;font-weight:400;line-height:1.5;">In 2021, hunger was once again on the rise in Haiti due to economic decline, climate change and natural disasters. Support from donors helped WFP provide vital cash assistance to the most vulnerable, boosting local economies and empowering communities. When a powerful earthquake struck Haiti in August 2021, EU funds also helped WFP respond quickly to assist those whose homes had been destroyed.  </p>

<h1 class="stripe-video__title" style="text-align:left"><span class="halden">Mozambique</span></h1>
<p style="font-size:16pt;font-weight:400;line-height:1.5;">The EU supported WFP’s response in the north of Mozambique, a region experiencing one of the fastest-growing displacement crises brought on by violence. Thanks to the EU’s funds, WFP provided vouchers or monthly food rations that consisted of rice, pulses and oil in places where supplies were available. </p>

      <div class="stripe-image__text">

<h1 class="stripe-video__title" style="text-align:left"><span class="halden">Central Sahel</span></h1>
<p style="font-size:16pt;font-weight:400;line-height:1.5;">In 2021, WFP provided food and nutrition support to vulnerable communities in the <strong>Central Sahel</strong>—comprising <strong>Burkina Faso</strong>, <strong>Mali</strong> and <strong>Niger</strong>—thanks to funding from the EU. The programme helps strengthens local, regional and national food systems by boosting the production, conservation, processing and consumption of nutritious foods.</p>

<h1 class="stripe-video__title" style="text-align:left"><span class="halden">Bangladesh</span></h1>
<p style="font-size:16pt;font-weight:400;line-height:1.5;">In <strong>Bangladesh</strong>, the EU also supported WFP’s food and nutrition programmes targeting refugees living in Cox’s Bazar. With WFP e-vouchers, beneficiaries could buy fresh and nutritious foods in the shops and markets set up in the world’s largest refugee camp. WFP also provided mothers and young children with nutrition advice and support. </p>

<h1 class="stripe-video__title" style="text-align:left"><span class="halden">Tanzania</span></h1>
<p style="font-size:16pt;font-weight:400;line-height:1.5;">Although <strong>Tanzania</strong> produces over 90 percent of its own food requirements, access to adequate food remains a problem for many households. Many families also face challenges in both accessing and understanding sensitive nutritional information. In 2021, thanks to donors like the EU, WFP helped communities improve their knowledge on nutrition, dietary diversity, and water, sanitation and hygiene through social behaviour change communication, diversification of food production and distribution of specialized nutritious foods. </p>

      <div class="stripe-image__text">
        Every day, millions of children go to school on an empty stomach. And millions more—particularly girls—don't go to school because their families need them to work. WFP has six decades of experience supporting school feeding. Better health and nutrition allow children to learn and perform better, building human capital.

<h1 class="stripe-video__title" style="text-align:left"><span class="halden">South Sudan</span></h1>
<p style="font-size:16pt;font-weight:400;line-height:1.5;">Girls in <strong>South Sudan</strong> are more likely than boys to be excluded from education. In some parts of the country, it is estimated that over 75 percent of primary-school-aged girls are not in school. Critically, school feeding helps put a stop to early marriage which can trap young mothers in particular in poverty, posing huge risks to their health. Thanks to support from the EU, WFP’s school feeding programme motivated families to keep their daughters in school. </p>

<h1 class="stripe-video__title" style="text-align:left"><span class="halden">Mali</span></h1>
<p style="font-size:16pt;font-weight:400;line-height:1.5;">In <strong>Mali</strong>, the EU helped launch a support programme to increase inclusion in schools, which aims to reintegrate 250,000 children, at least 50% of whom are out-of-school or out-of-school girls, into the education system. In addition to supporting children's education, the programme empowered women by helping them produce vegetables and fruits in school gardens—part of which was given to the schools while the other half was sold on the market. </p>

<p style="font-size:16pt;font-weight:400;line-height:1.5;">Together with donors like the EU, WFP worked with governments and partners to ensure that by 2030 people will have substantially increased access to national social protection schemes that safeguard and foster their ability to meet their food security, nutrition and associated essential needs, and to manage the risks and shocks they face. </p>
<p style="font-size:16pt;font-weight:400;line-height:1.5;">In <strong>Lebanon</strong>, for example, WFP helped the government provide cash assistance to Syrian refugees living in the country as well as the Lebanese host communities, as part of nation social protection programmes. This was made possible thanks to donors like the EU. </p>

      <div class="field-rich-text--container mv4 mv5-lg">
    <div>
              <p>The Philippines is an archipelago of over 7,600  islands. For three consecutive years, it has had the  highest disaster risk worldwide , due to its exposure and vulnerability to natural hazards compounded by low coping capacities.</p>
<p>Through sustained post-pandemic recovery efforts, the Philippines is on track towards achieving upper-middle-income status, remaining as one of the fastest-growing economies in Southeast Asia and the Pacific. Amid challenges in achieving Zero Hunger (Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) 2) and Partnerships for the Goals (SDG 17), the country has made moderate progress in 12 of the 17 SDGs.</p>
<p>The Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) saw notable improvements, underscored by a drop in the region’s poverty rate from 60 percent in 2018 to 32 percent in 2023. Within the country, the BARMM remains one of the regions with high poverty and malnutrition rates, due to recurrent natural hazards and conflict-related risks. Cultural norms add further constraints, particularly on women’s livelihood opportunities, with restricted access to basic social services.</p>
<p>The World Food Programme (WFP) has supported the Government in delivering emergency response to natural hazards and armed conflicts, while gradually shifting to capacity strengthening through technical support and augmentation of the disaster risk management capacities of government authorities.</p>
<p>Today, WFP supports the Government in achieving food and nutrition security, by strengthening disaster risk management, social protection, and food systems and capacities to enhance institutional and community resilience.  </p>

  <h2 class="page-stripe__title wfp-wrapper">What the World Food Programme is doing in the Philippines</h2>
  



<section class="accordion wfp-wrapper">

  <dl class="accordion__items" data-js-hook="accordion__items" data-once="accordion">
          <dt class="accordion__item-title" data-js-hook="accordion__item-title" tabindex="0" aria-controls="accordion-panel-1" aria-expanded="true">
        <div>
          <h3>Disaster risk management </h3>
        </div>
      </dt>
      <dd class="accordion__item-panel" id="accordion-panel-1" aria-hidden="false">
        <div class="accordion__item-content">WFP supports the Government of the Philippines in preparing for and responding to shocks through technical assistance and capacity strengthening, innovative technology, and enhancing humanitarian supply chain management. WFP’s support involves designing and pre-positioning critical response assets and infrastructure, contributing to strengthening the capacity of disaster management professionals at national and local levels, and supporting policy and legislative development. In the event of a sudden-onset emergency, WFP maintains a capacity to provide food or cash assistance to communities as well as emergency logistics and telecommunications support to government responders.</div>
                  <aside class="accordion__item-side">
                          <div class="accordion__item-image">
                <img src="https://www.wfp.org/sites/default/files/styles/page_accordion/public/images/20241026_WFP-Earvin_Perias-13.jpg?itok=IH6onJJT" alt="Person carrying three boxes on shoulder walks beside yellow truck displaying a World Food Programme banner.">
              </div>
                                  </aside>
              </dd>
          <dt class="accordion__item-title" data-js-hook="accordion__item-title" tabindex="0" aria-controls="accordion-panel-2" aria-expanded="false">
        <div>
          <h3>Disaster Risk Financing and Anticipatory Action </h3>
        </div>
      </dt>
      <dd class="accordion__item-panel" id="accordion-panel-2" aria-hidden="true" inert="">
        <div class="accordion__item-content">WFP has been a leader in supporting the Government’s integration of anticipatory action (AA) into disaster management and social protection systems. This includes the formulation of a global first-of-its-kind “Declaration of State of Imminent Disaster Act,” which will allow the Government to harness domestic resources for AA. WFP is also advancing additional disaster risk financing mechanisms, building on AA initiatives and its partnership with the Government to respond to Typhoon Haiyan (2013) and a series of successive typhoons in 2024. We do this by quickly providing cash to vulnerable populations through social protection programmes. These efforts support a more predictable, shock-responsive social protection system and enhance the resilience of smallholder farmers.</div>
                  <aside class="accordion__item-side">
                          <div class="accordion__item-image">
                <img src="https://www.wfp.org/sites/default/files/styles/page_accordion/public/images/IMG_4725.JPG?itok=V3YYclqD" alt="Person scans QR code on smartphone using blue device. Table holds another device and printed materials.">
              </div>
                                  </aside>
              </dd>
          <dt class="accordion__item-title" data-js-hook="accordion__item-title" tabindex="0" aria-controls="accordion-panel-3" aria-expanded="false">
        <div>
          <h3>Nutrition and cross-cutting priorities </h3>
        </div>
      </dt>
      <dd class="accordion__item-panel" id="accordion-panel-3" aria-hidden="true" inert="">
        <div class="accordion__item-content">WFP provides technical support to the Government in formulating or enhancing strategies to address malnutrition, such as active involvement in the Scaling Up Nutrition Movement and Government-led technical working groups. WFP supports the strengthening of national and local systems to design and more effectively implement social and behaviour change, by incorporating nutritional messages among other topics, and has been a lead partner in advocating for and scaling up the fortification of rice. All WFP actions are anchored on the principle of “leaving no one behind”.</div>
                  <aside class="accordion__item-side">
                          <div class="accordion__item-image">
                <img src="https://www.wfp.org/sites/default/files/styles/page_accordion/public/images/20240506_WFP-Earvin_Perias-042%20%282%29.jpg?itok=U9lwPJIk" alt="Person in blue WFP shirt, hairnet and gloves operates machine dispensing grains into container.">
              </div>
                                  </aside>
              </dd>
          <dt class="accordion__item-title" data-js-hook="accordion__item-title" tabindex="0" aria-controls="accordion-panel-4" aria-expanded="false">
        <div>
          <h3>Social protection</h3>
        </div>
      </dt>
      <dd class="accordion__item-panel" id="accordion-panel-4" aria-hidden="true" inert="">
        <div class="accordion__item-content">As the Government’s partner of choice in strengthening national systems, WFP contributes to enhancing social protection programmes to become more nutrition-sensitive and shock-responsive. In support of the Government’s commitments to the School Meals Coalition to deliver nutritious meals to all schoolchildren by 2030, WFP sources food locally from smallholder farmers and fortifies rice with iron to alleviate vitamin and mineral deficiencies. To address hunger and malnutrition, WFP assists the Government in piloting and expanding nationally the Walang Gutom (No Hunger) 2027 programme, to provide families facing severe food insecurity with electronic food vouchers coupled with social and behavioural change communications.</div>
                  <aside class="accordion__item-side">
                          <div class="accordion__item-image">
                <img src="https://www.wfp.org/sites/default/files/styles/page_accordion/public/images/20241016_WFP-Earvin_Perias-59.jpg?itok=lh5LMdiV" alt="Two children in white shirts sit closely, eating from bowls with spoons.">
              </div>
                                  </aside>
              </dd>
          <dt class="accordion__item-title" data-js-hook="accordion__item-title" tabindex="0" aria-controls="accordion-panel-5" aria-expanded="false">
        <div>
          <h3>Climate change adaptation, social cohesion and integrated resilience</h3>
        </div>
      </dt>
      <dd class="accordion__item-panel" id="accordion-panel-5" aria-hidden="true" inert="">
        <div class="accordion__item-content">WFP works with the national and BARMM governments to strengthen the resilience of communities and food systems against shocks. This involves increasing agricultural productivity through sustainable, community-led livelihood projects, coupled with social and behaviour change strategies promoting healthy nutrition. Through technical support, WFP strengthens government capacities for disaster risk management and climate change adaptation, and contributes to effective policy formulation for resilience programmes. WFP links smallholder farmers to institutional markets (schools, hospitals and penitentiaries) to improve their income and people’s access to fresh, nutritious commodities. Nationally, WFP helped the Government to model and scale up a national flagship programme focused on ensuring access to water to support rural livelihoods. In BARMM, WFP has been supporting efforts to ensure peace dividends and social cohesion.</div>
                  <aside class="accordion__item-side">
                          <div class="accordion__item-image">
                <img src="https://www.wfp.org/sites/default/files/styles/page_accordion/public/images/20240723_WFP-Earvin_Perias-070%20%281%29.jpg?itok=UAQbIGPz" alt="Person in black headscarf and red-blue patterned clothing sits on ground among small plants in shade, with other people in the background.">
              </div>
                                  </aside>
              </dd>
      </dl>

</section>
